- `provider: pi-coding-agent`
- `subprovider: openai`
- `base_url: OPENAI_ENDPOINT`

```text
OPENAI_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:10531/v1
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-5.3-codex-spark
```
